# Shuja Ahmed, DevOps and Cloud Engineer

> Portfolio and blog of Shuja Ahmed, a freelance DevOps and Cloud engineer based in Karachi, Pakistan. He builds lean, automated cloud infrastructure on AWS, GCP and Azure: Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, monitoring, and cloud cost optimization. His rule: if a human does it twice, automate it.

## Services

- [Services](https://www.shujaahmed.dev/services): Kubernetes cluster setup, Jenkins and GitHub Actions CI/CD, Terraform starter setups, monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana, GitOps with ArgoCD, cloud cost optimization, and lean infrastructure setup for startups and small teams.

## About

- [About](https://www.shujaahmed.dev/about): background and working style.
- [Portfolio](https://www.shujaahmed.dev/portfolio): projects, including FitLyfe (a calorie tracker backend run on a small K3s fleet on AWS for about $0.64 a day) and LearnStack (a learning platform shipped on AWS ECS).
